decisions.reason: The selected keyword remains mapped to the Back to School page; changing who applies that page's SEO edits does not change keyword selection or mapping.
The candidate concerns missing ALT attributes identified on the homepage, while the source decision only changes the implementation mode for edits to the Back to School page.
The source decision does not change the requested coverage or type of the on-page SEO completion report.
The candidate history does not establish that its webpage-content revision is the Back to School page addressed by the source decision.
Backlink creation is an off-page SEO task and is unaffected by who applies edits to the Back to School page.
The source decision concerns edits to a landing page and does not alter blog quantity, publication conditions, or delivery.
Backlink indexing and reporting remain unchanged by the implementation arrangement for Back to School page edits.
The source decision does not change the requirement to include search-volume data in the keyword research sheet.
The candidate governs internal links in blog articles, not edits to the Back to School landing page.
The source decision changes only how Back to School page edits will be applied and does not modify the selected blog keywords or replacement rule.
